description: soarm-speed fast profile for models trained on the rollout-1113 data (ck300-r1113c, intro v5 / compact_v1): the fast profile's motion, perception-service and harness options, but the driver keeps the training protocol where it shapes what the model sees or writes: T 1.0, 16 k kept after compaction (49,536 compaction point via CONTEXT_LIMIT 60000), output cap 4096. Only a thinking budget of 1024 tokens is added (teacher thinking is longer per turn; the cap bounds runaway turns). Deploy/eval only; motion options NEED A HUMAN SAFETY REVIEW before the real arm.
